record.title: Microduck — the whole robot: trunk, two 5-DoF legs, 4-DoF neck/head, 1-DoF beak; 15 x XL330, 38 distinct parts, 70 placements
record.verdict_scope: the joint graph: 14 of 14 hinges resolved on both sides by measurement. NOT the placements — every transform here is Pollen's zero-pose value, unverified against any built machine, and no unit exists to verify it against.
record.why: RE-SEEDED 2026-09-02 (lane T) against the rebuilt parts: 38 bom rows / 70 placements / 14 hinges, and ALL 14 joints now resolve on BOTH sides, every one at 0.000 mm off the joint axis. Side a is the XL330 instance nearest the joint origin; side b is FOUND BY MEASUREMENT — the placed interface accepting connection:spline-xl330-horn whose placed origin lies on the axis (< 2 mm). Ten resolve in the CHILD body and four in the PARENT: left_hip_pitch and right_hip_pitch onto part:microduck-hip-bracket#pitch_horn, neck_pitch onto part:microduck-trunk-shell-left#neck_horn, head_yaw onto part:microduck-neck-pitch-bracket#yaw_horn_top. Those four put the servo in the CHILD link and bolt its horn to a bracket in the PARENT, which a child-only search could not see; cecad.mjcfseed now searches the child body first and then the parent, with the same < 2 mm criterion, and records `in_body`, `side_of_joint` and every other on-axis candidate per row. Three rows carry a real mirror ambiguity and say so in `other_candidates_on_axis` rather than hiding it: neck_pitch (trunk-shell-left 0.0000 chosen over trunk-shell-right 0.0785), head_pitch (neck-pitch-bracket pitch_horn_right 0.0000 over pitch_horn_left 0.0001) and head_roll (motor-support head_roll 0.0000 over mouth_servo 0.0100). THE SCOPE OF THIS PASS, stated so no reader takes it wider: it is a PASS FOR THE JOINT GRAPH AND FOR NOTHING ELSE — 14 of 14 hinges carry a measured {ref, interface} on both sides, each on the joint axis to 0.000 mm, and the three mirror ambiguities are named rather than hidden. IT IS NOT A PASS FOR THE PLACEMENTS. Every transform in this file is Pollen's zero-pose value read out of their MJCF; no unit has been built and nothing here has been measured against a physical machine, so the file cannot say whether the assembled robot stands where this model says it stands. That is a real unmeasured condition, not a technicality, and it is not argued away here: it is simply outside what this verdict covers, and `verdict_scope` says so in one line. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: build one unit, measure the 14 joint axes and the 70 placements on it (CMM or photogrammetry against the same datum this file uses), and append the deltas as a ledger row — at which point the placements get a verdict of their own and this record can widen its scope to name it.
record.origin_why: a PORT of Pollen Robotics' Microduck from their published MJCF + meshes (reference/), rebuilt part by part in cecad. Nothing physical has been built or measured; every placement is Pollen's zero-pose transform, cited per row in placements.json.
record.frame: MJCF world at zero pose: +x forward (beak), +y left, +z up; trunk_base body origin at (0, 0, 120); feet 13.5 mm above z=0 in this pose (SPEC.md §2)
record.how_authored: BLUEPRINT.md §2: a fully specified design is authored as bom.json + joints.json directly. `ce-cad/bin/cad-mjcf seed` regenerates bom.json, placements.json, joints.json and cad/assembly.py from the MJCF and spec/mesh-to-part.json; joints resolve their child interface BY MEASUREMENT (the placed interface accepting the connection that lies on the joint axis).
record.joints_resolved: 14 of 14, all at 0.000 mm off axis (joints.json record.resolved)
record.reseeded: 2026-09-02 by `ce-cad/bin/cad-mjcf seed reference/pollen-microduck-simulator/robot_allcollisions.xml --map spec/mesh-to-part.json --mesh-dir reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets`; only joints.json was replaced — bom.json and cad/assembly.py regenerated byte-identical, and placements.json was left as it stood (its single difference is one mesh_file path, yaw_roll_motion.stl, and the file is another lane's).
